pictures.name: MN1-Hungry-Desert
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. A dry desert wilderness at harsh midday, rocky hills and a camp of simple tents. In the middle, a weary family of freed slaves in dusty plain wool robes sits by their tent with empty clay bowls: a tired father with a short black beard in a faded blue robe, a mother in an ochre head cloth, an old grandmother. Others gather nearby, frowning, gesturing. Pale sky, deep blue shadows under the tents.

pictures.name: MN2-Like-Frost
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Dawn in the desert camp. The dew is lifting like mist, and the ground all around the tents is covered with fine white flakes like frost, glittering in the first gold light. The same mother in an ochre head cloth kneels in the middle, picking up a few flakes in her palm, amazed; the father in a faded blue robe bends beside her, asking. Soft gold and blue, wonder.

pictures.name: MN3-Gathering
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Morning in the desert camp. People of every age gather the fine white flakes from the ground into woven baskets and clay jars: the mother in an ochre head cloth, the father in a faded blue robe, the grandmother, neighbors. Each basket holds about the same. Warm gold morning light, peaceful busy mood.

pictures.name: MN4-Double-Portion
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Late afternoon in the desert camp, the sixth day. The mother in an ochre head cloth and the grandmother knead and bake flat breads on a hot stone by the tent, baskets brimming with twice as much white manna beside them. Far off near the tents, Moses, a tiny far-off figure in a dark robe with a staff, seen only from behind or far away, speaks to a small gathered group. Warm golden light, a feeling of preparation.

pictures.name: MN5-Empty-Ground
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Morning of the seventh day in the desert camp. In the foreground, two men with empty baskets stand on bare, empty sand, puzzled. Behind them the camp is at rest: the family in ochre and faded blue sits together peacefully in the shade of their tent, an ox and a donkey lying down nearby. Soft clear gold light, deep blue shadows, stillness.

pictures.name: MN6-Two-Loaves
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Today: a modern family dining room on Friday evening at sunset, painted in the same oil style. In the middle, two braided golden challah loaves rest on the table under an embroidered cloth, beside two lit candles. A family of three generations sits down together, smiling, a grandmother lifting the edge of the cloth. Warm candlelight, deep blue window.
